defects.detail: Two ids carry byte-identical text. The library keeps the emitted id WITH its duplicate defect recorded, and carries the dropped id as a withheld record with code: null - so the collision is visible from both sides and the artifact never stores the same text twice. Which id survives is an editorial decision about the source document, not something a build should settle by sort order.
defects.decision: Reconcile the source document: keep one id for this function and delete the other. The library will then report one clean record and no defect.
